2126631063078281589.en_summary: The Biotech Report: $INSM bought out for $175 per share cash, removing my top pick. Now searching for next. $BBIO stepping up to top pick with 2 drugs approved, 4 within next year, peak sales ~$8B plus pipeline. $PTGX #3 with 2 commercial drugs, early pipeline. $PRAX #4, 2 drugs up for approval with big potential, data in broader DEE could drive value. $IDYA broad pipeline, peak potential ~$5B+. $COGT commercial single drug >$4B peak sales, needs data. $IMNM lead drug awaiting approval, early pipeline. $SYRE and $ORKA added, overvalued/fully valued but big pipeline potential if data validates. $DFTX and $BLTE single drug with multi-indication potential, need more drugs.
2126631063078281589.zh_summary: 生物科技報告：$INSM 以每股175美元現金收購，移除我的首選。現正尋找下一個。$BBIO 晉升為首選，已批准2款藥物，明年內將有4款，峰值銷售約80億美元加上管線。$PTGX 排名第三，有2款商業化藥物及早期管線。$PRAX 排名第四，2款藥物待批准，潛力大，更廣泛DEE數據或推動價值。$IDYA 廣泛管線，峰值潛力約50億美元以上。$COGT 商業化單藥峰值銷售超過40億美元，需數據。$IMNM 領先藥物待批准，早期管線。$SYRE 與 $ORKA 昨日加入，估值偏高/充分但若數據驗證則管線潛力大。$DFTX 與 $BLTE 單藥多適應症潛力，需開發更多藥物。

2126617345569567144.en_summary: Elon Musk on $SPCX compute rental price trends (relevant for $NBIS, Neocloud etc.): Large, highly interconnected, high-bandwidth training clusters seeing rising rental prices, some significantly. Small clusters (~5,000 GPUs or below) prices declining. Overall, SpaceX compute business average per-GPU rental price is rising. Contrasts with recent market selloff on oversupply fears.
2126617345569567144.zh_summary: Elon Musk 談 $SPCX 算力租賃價格走勢（對 $NBIS、Neocloud 等具參考意義）：大規模、高度互聯、專為高帶寬訓練配置的算力集群租賃價格正在上漲，部分漲幅顯著。小規模集群（約5,000張GPU以下）價格正在下降。整體而言，SpaceX 算力業務單GPU平均租賃價格正在上漲。與近期因擔憂算力供過於求而拋售形成對比。

ticker_notes.SPCX: 大規模集群租賃價格上漲，整體平均價格上升
